globalAlias.name: __rp
globalAlias.collisionBehavior: If globalThis.__rp already exists with an incompatible value or ABI, do not replace it and disable the bridge facade safely; every internal call then uses its stock fallback or capture no-op.

policyQuery.exactFallback: Return the exact fallback argument, preserving identity for non-primitive fallback values even though bridge ABI 1 policy contracts currently use primitive fallbacks.
policyQuery.successSentinels: Valid false and 0 are results, never absence sentinels.
fallbackConditions: handler returns a Promise or any thenable
integer result is outside the policy-domain range
atomic renderer bundle is incomplete or incompatible

rawCapture.presenceBitmap: Non-negative integer whose bit N declares whether positional slot N is present; omitted slots never renumber later indexes.
rawCapture.clearSignal: presenceBitmap is 0 and slotsOrNull is null
rawCapture.publishOrReplace: A non-null positional slot array plus its presence bitmap publishes or atomically replaces captureDomainId at generation.
rawCapture.clear: presenceBitmap 0 with null slotsOrNull clears captureDomainId only when generation matches the currently published generation, preventing stale cleanup from deleting a newer capture.
rawCapture.invalidClear: A null slotsOrNull with nonzero presenceBitmap is invalid and becomes an ignored no-op.
rawCapture.failureBehavior: No-op with stock behavior preserved when the facade/runtime is absent, incompatible, disabled, colliding, invalid, or throws.

normalLaunchMetadata.ambientPolicy: The candidate wrapper rejects normal launch when any of the three names already exists in its environment.
normalLaunchMetadata.wrapperPolicy: After ambient rejection, the candidate wrapper hardcodes all three normal-mode values from its selected signed RELEASE metadata and verified artifact.
normalLaunchMetadata.bootstrapPolicy: Bootstrap captures all three values before extension loading and immediately deletes all three names from process.env.

signedArtifactActivation.releaseAuthority: The selected signed RELEASE metadata, never ambient input or the current working directory.
requiredExactMatches: wrapper-supplied bridge build ID equals the signed RELEASE bridge build ID
wrapper-supplied target version equals the signed RELEASE target version
actual executable target version equals the wrapper-supplied target version
SHA-256 of the actual executable target equals the wrapper-supplied artifact SHA-256
signedArtifactActivation.stockSha256Role: target.stockSha256 records stock provenance and is not a substitute for verified signed-candidate artifact identity.
signedArtifactActivation.artifactSha256Value: Release-generated and wrapper-supplied; no temporary prototype artifact SHA-256 is frozen in this contract because later raw-capture sites change the final artifact.

stockLabCompatibility.rule: Stock-lab path and file-size compatibility may exercise runtime and harness behavior only; it cannot activate a signed candidate or satisfy unsafeRaw artifact identity.

notes: This manifest freezes the contract and observed supplier neighborhoods, not byte replacements.
Offsets and minified symbols are diagnostic observations for stock 2.1.220 only; later versions require semantic rediscovery.
Every planned physical consolidation remains subject to a disposable exact-version byte-fit and fallback prototype.

lifecycle.static: Published once at generation 0; identical recapture is a no-op and conflicting replacement is rejected.
lifecycle.provider: Atomically replaced for each provider generation and cleared with a generation-safe cleanup token.
lifecycle.render-latest: Replaced on every render generation; the previous graph is released immediately.
lifecycle.lookup-live: The published static registry/map remains valid, but the current live instance is resolved on demand.

sensitivity.operational: Paths, configuration, topology, or diagnostic state.
sensitivity.content: Conversation, prompt, command, tool, task, or transcript content.
sensitivity.decision: Model, routing, dialog, permission, or policy decision state.
sensitivity.terminal: Live frames, renderer state, or terminal output control.

accessTiers.name: external-runtime
accessTiers.contract: Trusted preload, legacy registry API v1, synchronous policy API v2, exact-target bridge manifest, environment cleanup, and safe bypass.

accessTiers.name: read
accessTiers.contract: Cloned, frozen, bounded, and redacted snapshots or metadata only; no live mutable object.

accessTiers.name: actions
accessTiers.contract: Narrow validated actions with allowlists, lifecycle checks, and stock-safe failure.

accessTiers.name: unsafe
accessTiers.contract: Exact-version raw handles only after explicit unsafeRaw opt-in and exact target/build/ABI negotiation.

accessTiers.name: overrides
accessTiers.contract: Separate synchronous primitive-only call-site queries with exact stock fallback; raw publication alone never changes lexical flow.

featureActivationTiers.name: atomic-renderer-bundle
featureActivationTiers.activationRule: Activate none of the renderer handlers unless policy domains 0, 1, and 2 are all present at ABI 1.

assetDomains.name: Model and context system
assetDomains.safeFallback: Use the complete stock model, provider, 1M, environment, and context-window paths.

assetDomains.name: Subagent routing
assetDomains.safeFallback: Use stock environment, inherit, frontmatter/default, allowlist, provider, 1M, alias, fallback, and telemetry behavior.

assetDomains.name: Messages and transcript pipeline
assetDomains.safeFallback: Retain stock show-all, transcript truncation, virtual-scroll, pre-normalization cap, and final cap behavior.

assetDomains.name: REPL live controls and commands
assetDomains.safeFallback: Do not dispatch, submit, or mutate stale controls; normal keyboard and UI behavior remains stock.

assetDomains.name: App state and dialogs
assetDomains.safeFallback: Return unavailable for an absent or stale provider; never answer dialogs or mutate permission state automatically.

assetDomains.name: Ink and terminal renderer
assetDomains.safeFallback: Use the stock full-reset planner and serializer; never emit renderpatch ED3 because the runtime is absent, partial, or incompatible.

assetDomains.name: Keybindings, actions, and command dispatch
assetDomains.safeFallback: Fail closed when stale and never bypass context, priority, dialog, or input-ownership checks.

assetDomains.name: Diagnostics and telemetry
assetDomains.safeFallback: Publish no diagnostics and invoke no telemetry; status never contains raw values or content-bearing payload history.

extensionContracts.failureBehavior: Publish none of the three handlers when any requirement is absent or incompatible.

policyDomains.name: renderer.messages

bits.1: Force effective disableRenderCap true for both cap computations.

policyDomains.stockEffect: Unset bits preserve the corresponding stock local values; fallback 0 preserves all stock props, truncation, and caps.

supplier.placement: Early in Messages after virtual-scroll state is known and before transcript truncation and both Xhf cap starts; fold bits into effective u/H while leaving the transcript JSX prop site stock.

policyDomains.name: renderer.reset
policyDomains.stockEffect: False preserves the stock start row and stock alt-screen-versus-main-screen serializer choice.

supplier.placement: One result must atomically drive startY=0 and the emitted clear patch's effective destructive intent while Hms remains stock.
supplier.goNoGo: Do not enable this domain unless row-zero replay and destructive clear are empirically atomic. If intent cannot safely reach the stock serializer, use one explicitly declared sixth policy query or treat the five-site prototype as no-go.

policyDomains.name: renderer.toggleRedraw
policyDomains.stockEffect: False preserves stock toggle state and telemetry and schedules no extra redraw.

policyDomains.name: provider.contextWindow
policyDomains.stockEffect: The exact stock result remains authoritative for Claude models and every failure path.

supplier.placement: A wide-enough SZc contextual replacement that computes the exact stock result first and supplies it as q fallback; do not treat the narrow canonical-model-only fit as the final contract.

policyDomains.stockEffect: Fallback preserves the first stock shortcut; the second default/frontmatter Xrd call and all later resolution remain stock.

policyLayout: One early lzb query for show-all and both cap decisions; transcript JSX props stay stock.
One CXr query for atomic row-zero/destructive reset intent; Hms stays stock if proven safe.
One Hui Ctrl+O query authorizing binary-owned oFS scheduling.
One wide-enough SZc tail query with exact precomputed stock fallback.
One ite query replacing only the first explicit Xrd gate.
rawSupplierInventory: d0 model/context/subagent statics near Ydt, one or two sites
d1 Ink statics/map near T3u/Ju_, with dialog/diagnostics folded where safe
d2 AppStateProvider only when non-REPL/early store availability is required
d3 Messages latest capture after Ze
d4 core REPL latest capture near OGt, optionally supplying d2
d5 keybinding provider capture after tp_
coLocationRules: d3 and policy domain 0 share lzb but may remain separate early/late replacements.
d2 may co-locate with d4 for REPL-only app-store access.
d0 may share neighborhoods with policy domains 3 or 4 only after scope and byte-fit proof.
d1 may share the reset neighborhood only if raw publication does not enlarge terminal-policy blast radius.
Policy domain 2 in Hui cannot replace the broad d4 Ahl capture.
physicalSitePlan.sixthPolicySiteFallback: Only after proof: split Messages into show-all plus shared-cap queries, or add terminal.clearMode to preserve atomic reset pairing.
physicalSitePlan.noGo: If destructive clear can partially enable without row-zero replay, or both consolidations fail and require uncontrolled policy-site expansion, reject the prototype rather than silently shipping seven or nine policy patches.
physicalSitePlan.rule: Do not force a mega-payload merely to lower site count.

exactMatches: requirements.target.version equals the verified target version
requirements.target.stockSha256 equals the separately verified stock provenance SHA-256 or approved signature-independent stock __BUN hash
requirements.target.artifactSha256 equals the independently computed SHA-256 of the actual verified executable target
requirements.target.bridgeBuildId equals the signed RELEASE bridge build ID
unsafeRawGate.deniedBehavior: Omit unsafe entirely while leaving compatible Tier 1 and Tier 2 capabilities available.

lifecycleRules.static: Generation 0; identical recapture is a no-op, conflicting replacement is rejected.
lifecycleRules.provider: Generation-monotonic atomic replace; cleanup token removes only its own generation; stale actions fail closed.
lifecycleRules.render-latest: Strictly increasing generation on every render; release previous arrays, refs, closures, and object graphs immediately; unmount cleanup is generation-safe.
lifecycleRules.lookup-live: Publish the stable map or registry, then resolve the current live instance on demand rather than retaining it in Tier 1.
lifecycleRules.boundedness: At most one current capture for each d0-d5 domain; slot omission uses the declared presence bitmap and never shifts later indexes.
lifecycleRules.staleAction: Return unavailable/stale and perform no mutation, dispatch, submission, dialog operation, or terminal write.

securityRules: Policy payloads and results are primitives only; no callback, setter, Ink instance, renderer object, resolver function, or raw graph crosses q.
The bridge facade exposes no eval and no arbitrary method dispatch.
Bootstrap and extension paths are explicit absolute user-owned regular files under the user's home, with parent-symlink and group/world-write checks.
Never discover or autoload code from the current project, .claude directories, package metadata, or relative module names.
Delete BUN_OPTIONS immediately, scrub child preload state, reject ambient BUN_OPTIONS in normal mode, and preserve exact-target --renderpatch-safe.

The candidate wrapper rejects ambient CLAUDE_RENDERPATCH_BRIDGE_BUILD_ID, CLAUDE_RENDERPATCH_BRIDGE_ARTIFACT_SHA256, and CLAUDE_RENDERPATCH_BRIDGE_TARGET_VERSION; hardcodes their verified values only for normal launch; and scrubs them from status, safe-mode, and child paths.
Bootstrap captures the three one-shot bridge metadata values and immediately deletes all three environment names before extension loading.

Signed artifact activation requires the signed RELEASE build ID and target version plus an independently computed actual-target SHA-256 equal to the wrapper-supplied artifact SHA-256; stock-lab path/size compatibility is test-only.
Tier 1 returns cloned, frozen, bounded, and redacted snapshots and never returns live mutable objects.
Tier 2 validates arguments, checks current generation/liveness, uses command/action allowlists, and fails closed when stale.

Tier 3 requires explicit unsafeRaw and exact target/build/ABI negotiation; raw messages, stores, setters, terminal instances, submit callbacks, dialog controls, and handler refs never appear in status or logs.
Normal facades never answer or bypass user-facing dialogs or permissions, and test-only reset methods remain excluded.
Status exposes only versions, domains, lifecycle, generation, slot presence bitmap/count, and health metadata; never handlers, values, payload history, credentials, or content-bearing paths.
Extension registration is transactional; numeric/readable alias collision or duplicate ownership rejects the whole extension.
Full-redraw is the only atomic multi-domain feature; context-window and subagent-routing failures do not disable each other.
Capture return values are ignored. Raw publication cannot alter Claude Code lexical control flow.
Patched-without-preload, bootstrap-only, partial/incompatible/throwing policy, and safe mode all preserve stock behavior and emit zero renderpatch ED3.
